list.name: us_state
list.label: US State
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT us_state FROM scores WHERE us_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY us_state

list.name: merch
list.label: Merchant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT merch FROM scores WHERE merch IS NOT NULL ORDER BY merch

panels.title: Плотность распределения скоров (score density)
panels.description: Распределение предсказанных вероятностей мошенничества для транзакций, отфильтрованных по US State / Merchant.

targets.rawSql: SELECT score FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND us_state IN (${us_state:sqlstring}) AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})

panels.title: TPS обработки транзакций
panels.description: Количество обработанных (записанных в scores) транзакций в секунду, отфильтрованных по US State / Merchant.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('second', created_at) AS "time", count(*)::float AS "tps" FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND us_state IN (${us_state:sqlstring}) AND merch IN (${merch:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Средняя доля фрода по категории продукта (последние 1000 транзакций)
panels.description: AVG(fraud_flag) по cat_id среди последних 1000 записанных транзакций (без фильтров по US State / Merchant).

targets.rawSql: SELECT cat_id, AVG(fraud_flag)::float AS fraud_rate FROM (SELECT cat_id, fraud_flag FROM scores WHERE cat_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1000) t GROUP BY cat_id ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC
